scope: Prospective complete metadata-only observed room audit. No estimation, payload access, model change or alternative acceptance.
coverage: Require the exact complete 1360 timestamps/statuses in both candidates and original score rows. Preserve all failures and unmatched references. Independently reconstruct Decimal timestamps, bounded SciPy SLERP, original first-jointly-valid SE3 gauge and nearest fixed 1s pair denominator/ties. Verify original full translation/rotation rows, RMSEs and frozen raw/causal audit bindings before descriptive output.
adjacent: For every consecutive planned pair (i-1,i), compute inv(actual[i-1])*actual[i] and inv(truth[i-1])*truth[i]; compare proper rigid translation and principal SO3 angle. Missing truth/status stays explicit. Causal seeds, inverse direction and world composition must match original receipts. No new alignment or interpolation across missing samples.
per_frame: Keep every planned index/time/status/reference mask. Output original first-gauge translation and principal rotation errors and vectors, adjacent actual/reference motion and error, original registration raw count/fraction/photo/depth/support statistics with exact source audit comparison.
one_second: Keep every original planned source/target pair, including unevaluated gaps; independently rederive translation/rotation errors. Window covariates are arithmetic means of all constituent adjacent reports (i+1..j), never a selected subset.
bins: Eight chronological bins assigned by floor(8*index/N); adjacent pairs by target row and 1s pairs by source row. Count every planned/matched/missing/error observation. Full unweighted SSE contributions sum back to original denominators and RMSEs; report rotation errors separately without inventing rotation acceptance.
associations: Descriptive Pearson correlations only: adjacent translation/rotation errors vs five raw scalar covariates and 1s translation/rotation errors vs complete-window mean covariates. Constant or fewer-than-two observations produce explicit undefined reasons. Scaled centered fsum arithmetic; no causal or inferential claim, selection, p-values or acceptance change.
comparison: Compare both original first-gauge trajectories on exactly their common original reference mask; report all per-row pose differences and whole-timeline distributions, never fit a new gauge or choose intervals from the result.
plot: Four fixed full-timeline panels: original per-row aligned translation/rotation error, adjacent translation error and original 1s translation RPE. Retain NaN gaps, disable path simplification; original global acceptance remains separate from pointwise curves. Fixed labels, no hidden filtering. Static SVG and PNG preview with standard Matplotlib Agg; all observations remain in JSON.

preservation.policy: Protect every preflight scientific JSON/native hash and both complete source studies; fail closed on complete inventories. No payload copy/download, native build/install, image/archive read, new fit or altered score. Delete only exact passing owned pytest basetemps after XML/terminal/absolute/no-reparse checks.

verification: Independent closed-form/synthetic rigid drift, rotation near zero/180 degrees, epochs/SLERP/gaps/RPE ties, scalar/causal/coverage/schema/IO mutation tests; focused and complete Python tests with original three skips; freeze source before audit and independent post-audit recomputation/record checks.
unchanged: Rust vision/core/math/GPU, native Python bridge/stub and runtime dependencies/defaults remain byte-identical to parent. Runtime hidden H/J unobserved; association is descriptive and all recordings already observed development.
remaining: Room robustness, genuinely unobserved motion qualification, both raw Linux hardware classes, canonical matching measured clock uncertainty/physical frame accuracy and complete canonical mapping/semantic/Viewer/interchange/release acceptance remain required for operational 80%.
